content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Orlando

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's exact education and experience thresholds now—many Orlando professionals in hospitality, healthcare, and defense sectors meet these requirements. Granite PM Academy can help you verify eligibility before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our nationwide platform delivers all required contact hours online, on a schedule that fits working professionals. Active certified practitioners teach real-world scenarios and exam strategy—no recorded lectures, no self-paced gaps.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing Granite PM Academy's training, submit your formal PMI application with proof of education, project experience, and the 35 contact hours. Pay PMI's exam fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Allow time for PMI's review process before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation support, including practice questions and strategy coaching. You'll sit for the computer-delivered exam at a PMI-approved testing center. Our instructors equip you with the frameworks and confidence to demonstrate mastery of project-management domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification renews every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or continued education. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you maintain your credential and stay current with evolving project-management practices throughout your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
